svg.text: Globe wireframe — rotation around tilted (Y+Z) axis
✓ Expected: Wireframe globe rotates around an axis 45° between body Y and body Z. Off-axis spin, more chaotic than pure-Y.
✗ If broken: Same look as 11.1 — means the axis isn't actually tilted.
